title: Chama, father of Rav Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Sanhedrin 81a: the father of Rav Yosef bar Chama asked Rabbah bar Natan. Hyman identifies him as the father of Rava's grandfather, citing Eruvin 54a and Nedarim 55a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “Father of Rava’s grandfather” preserves Hyman’s stated genealogy; no family relationship is silently harmonized.

Sanhedrin 81a supplies the father of Rav Yosef bar Chama asking Rabbah bar Natan. The reviewed Eruvin 54a and Nedarim 55a paragraphs name Rava son of Rav Yosef bar Chama. Hyman’s stated “father of Rava’s grandfather” is retained without a new genealogical repair or admission.
